intro.title: BUILD
intro.paragraph: Samuel works with young Africans who are done waiting for permission to build wealth. Through consulting, community, and content — he helps ambitious people turn the businesses they have into the businesses they actually want.

about.heading: Samuel didn't start as a business consultant. He trained as a pharmacist.
paragraphs: But somewhere between studying compounds and watching people around him struggle to build anything sustainable, he realized the problem wasn't resources. It was the absence of a business mind.
That realization became everything he does today.

Samuel is the CEO of Outbrooks Technology Limited, Founder of Sigmart YAE, and the author of The Economy of the Young African Mind. He speaks, teaches, consults, and builds — all toward one thing: equipping young Africans to create real wealth, not just income.
The work is personal. This continent has everything it needs. It just has to think differently about it.

offers.title: 90-Day Business Growth Consulting
offers.description: Your business should be growing. If it isn't, something needs to change. Samuel works directly with small business owners who are stuck — making sales but not scaling, working hard but not building. Over 90 days, he goes into the business, finds what's holding it back, and builds a clear path forward. This isn't generic advice. It's specific, strategic, and built around the client's actual numbers and actual market.
features: A full audit of your business model and current gaps
A 90-day growth roadmap built for your context
Weekly strategy sessions with direct accountability
Access to frameworks that work for African markets

offers.title: Speaking Engagements
offers.description: The right message, delivered to the right room, changes everything. Samuel speaks on business strategy, leadership, and the mindset behind building real wealth — to corporate teams, universities, conferences, and youth organizations across Africa and beyond. These aren't motivational talks for their own sake. Every session is built to leave the audience with a shift in how they think and a clear direction for what to do next.
features: Building wealth from the ground up — the mindset and the mechanics
Business strategy for the African market
The economy of the young African mind
offers.closing: If you're organizing an event and want a speaker who will add real value to your audience, reach out.

book.title: THE ECONOMY OF THE YOUNG AFRICAN MIND
book.author: By Samuel Adanuvo
book.description: This book is about what happens when a young African decides to think like a builder instead of a survivor. It covers the mental frameworks, the economic realities, and the wealth principles that most people on this continent were never taught — and what changes when they finally are.
book.quote: “Unless you rewire your internal economy and retrain your thinking, beliefs, and sense of possibility, nothing that flows out of you will create any meaningful impact or lasting wealth.”
book.status: The full release is coming. Be among the first to know.
